items.content:
The hit sci-fi franchise with a rich, sprawling world is set to get the live action treatment in the latest news about Cyberpunk 2077 :

The popular video game from CD Projekt Red has inspired art from fans and creatives alike, now it’s time to see the franchise in the flesh with the latest adaptation underway. The most recent news sheds a little light on how development is going.

The action-adventure role-playing game puts the player deep in the underbelly of the sprawling metropolis of Night City. Although the expansive nature of the game’s world gives players multiple storylines to follow, a key character is Keanu Reeves’ Johnny Silverhand, a mercenary in a tech-obsessed world. There’s no doubt the adaptation will touch upon themes of power, glamour and body modification.

The film is being made for Paramount Pictures, with Lorenzo di Bonaventura ( Snake Eyes ) producing.

items.title: 'Cyberpunk 2077' Movie in the Works at Paramount
items.summary: Paramount is developing a live-action 'Cyberpunk 2077' movie with 'Transformers' producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura and CD Projekt Red. Here’s what we know.
items.content:
Night City is heading to the big screen, as Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action movie set in the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , with game developer CD Projekt Red on board as a co-producer.

Deadline broke the news on Oct. 8, confirmed by Variety the same day. Here’s what we know so far.

Lorenzo di Bonaventura, the producer behind the Transformers and G.I. Joe movies, will produce alongside CD Projekt Red.

CD Projekt Red co-CEO Michał Nowakowski confirmed the partnership on X , saying Paramount “shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise.”

He added that the studio looks forward to sharing more details “at the appropriate time,” so we’ll be waiting on updates.

No director, writer, cast or release date has been announced. Deadline reports the movie will tell a new story set in the Cyberpunk universe.

That’s the same approach the anime Cyberpunk: Edgerunners took on Netflix.

In the game, players take on V, a mercenary whose head is home to a biochip carrying the consciousness of rock star Johnny Silverhand, played by Keanu Reeves.

It’s unclear whether Keanu is attached to the movie, and neither studio has said whether the game’s main characters will appear.

Gameranx notes that Keanu and Idris Elba, who starred in the game’s Phantom Liberty expansion, have both expressed interest in a project like this.

Also read about: A Definitive Ranking of Live-Action Video Game Movie Adaptations

The Cyberpunk 2077 deal is the studio’s third major video game grab lately, following Street Fighter and Call of Duty .

Paramount also recently completed its merger with Warner Bros. under the Skydance name.

Video game adaptations are having a moment on the big screen, too. Check out the first reactions to Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil to see how critics are feeling about the trend.

items.title: Paramount Making a Movie in the World of Cyberpunk 2077
Cyberpunk 2077 to get a live-action adaptation
items.summary: CD Projekt Red is currently in the process of developing a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film alongside Paramount Pictures.
items.content:
Only a few days ago , I noted that we're entering another golden age of video game adaptations after the 90s put us off the whole idea for a while. I love when I'm proven right almost immediately.

Unlike The Finals or ARC Raiders , Cyberpunk 2077 's biggest strength is arguably its world and story: the game is an adaptation of a tabletop roleplaying universe that's been running since the 80s, and its revised version of that world has spawned spinoffs of its own. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is a pretty damn good anime that's returning for a second season in the near future, but Cyberpunk evidently has bigger ambitions than that. Mountain-sized ambitions, in fact.

CD Projekt Red is currently in the process of developing a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film alongside Paramount Pictures and producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura of Madam Web fame. (Remember Madam Web? No? He'd probably prefer it that way.) Details beyond that are sparse at the moment, however, aside from a boilerplate statement that was handed to Polygon:

"We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise," said Michał Nowakowski, joint-CEO of CD Projekt, in a statement. "We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time."

Edgerunners wasn't a straightforward adaptation of the game's story, so I wouldn't expect this unnamed, undated movie to be either, as cool as it'd be to see Keanu Reeves' Johnny Silverhand in live action. Night City has a million unfolding dramas in it, and I just hope whichever one CDPR lands on turns out half as gripping as the game itself.

CDPR Issues New Official Statement on Cyberpunk 2077's Live-Action Movie From GameRant (Written by Joshua Duckworth) on October 9, 2026 | OpenCritic

Video game adaptations have become a major part of Hollywood's plans, with studios increasingly looking to established gaming franchises for their next big releases, and a new adaptation is coming for Cyberpunk 2077 . Even Xbox has opened a new division with the intent of expanding its IP beyond video games, so the increase in these video game adaptations should surprise no one. From live-action adaptations to animated series, recognizable games are finding new audiences beyond consoles and PC. For developers, these projects also offer an opportunity to expand their fictional worlds without replacing the games that made them popular in the first place.

Few modern RPGs have built a world quite like Cyberpunk 2077 . CD Projekt Red's action-adventure game takes players to Night City, a sprawling metropolis where advanced technology, corporate power, and underground crime collide. Its setting has since expanded beyond the original game through additional content and other media like Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , making the franchise a natural candidate for another adaptation. Now, its next major screen project is beginning to take shape.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 movie adaptation from Paramount on the way
items.summary: The smash hit from the studio behind The Witcher series is to be turned into a film by Paramount Pictures.
items.content:
Share Save Add as preferred on Google Tom Richardson BBC Newsbeat CD Projekt Red The Cyberpunk 2077 video game featured Keanu Reeves in one of the main roles A live-action movie version of smash hit video game Cyberpunk 2077 is being developed by Paramount Pictures.

The Hollywood studio is working with producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura, known for his work on the Transformers films, and CD Projekt Red (CDPR), the developer of the sci-fi role-playing game.

CDPR's joint-chief executive Michał Nowakowski said in a statement the company was "excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise".

Details of the film's story, potential release date and casting information are yet to be revealed.

Despite a troubled launch in 2020 , the Cyberpunk 2077 video game, which stars Keanu Reeves, has sold more than 40 million copies worldwide.

The John Wick star plays rockstar Johnny Silverhand, a terrorist whose consciousness is stored on a chip inside the body of main character V.

Set in Night City, a fictional metropolis in a dystopian version of California, players work to uncover a conspiracy involving the shady Arasaka megacorporation.

An expansion, Phantom Liberty, starring Idris Elba was released in 2023 and has sold more than 15 million copies, according to CDPR.

Cyberpunk has already been successfully adapted into a popular animated series - Edgerunners - with a second season due to premiere on Netflix later this month.

The streamer also produced The Witcher, an adaptation of CDPR's massively popular fantasy role-playing series.

It originally starred former Superman actor Henry Cavill, but he was replaced by Liam Hemsworth in the show's fourth season.

Multiple video game series have been adapted for TV and film in recent years, with more due to follow.

Two Super Mario movies, a big screen version of Minecraft and a series of Sonic the Hedgehog films have each seen global box office takings of about $1bn.

PlayStation game The Last of Us was made into a hit series by HBO, and Prime Video says its adaptation of post-apocalyptic role-playing series Fallout is one of its most-watched programmes.

In the game, a mercenary outlaw named V is on the search for a one-of-a-kind implant that doubles as a key to immortality. The game, whose knock-down, drag-out gunfights recall another first-person RPG, Call of Duty , drew a lot of initial buzz over the character Johnny Silverhand played by Reeves.

An expansion of the Cyberpunk 2077 game, Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty, has sold 15 million copies and stars Idris Elba as sleeper agent Solomon Reed. Projekt Red is also behind Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , the Netflix series also set in the Night City dystopia and which followed the bow of Cyberpunk 2077 .

Edgerunners was animated by popular Japanese anime studio Studio Trigger and directed by Hiroyuki Imaishi, the team behind such series as Kill la Kill and Star Wars: Visions . Hollywood has developed a steady appetite for video game adaptations, especially on streaming platforms, after the success of HBO’s The Last of Us , a small-screen version of the 2013 action-adventure game from Naughty Dog and Sony, created by Chernobyl ‘s Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann, one of the game’s original directors.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Live-Action Movie Officially Announced
items.summary: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners was just the beginning...
items.content:
By Michael McWhertor Published Oct 8, 2026, 2:59 PM EDT Michael McWhertor is a New York-based journalist and editor with more than 20 years of experience covering games, industry events, technology, movies, and TV. News CD Projekt Red and Paramount Pictures are bringing Nighty City to the big screen

Image: CD Projekt Red Cyberpunk 2077 Sign in to your Polygon.com account Add Us Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread 4 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Johnny Silverhand is heading for the silver screen. CD Projekt Red's sci-fi role-playing game Cyberpunk 2077 is being adapted into a live-action movie at Paramount Pictures, according to a new report, with the longtime producer of the Transformers series overseeing the project. It's the latest video game adaptation from Paramount, which is also bringing Street Fighter and Call of Duty to live-action.

According to Deadline , Transformers producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura is attached to produce the movie alongside CD Projekt Red. Di Bonaventura is also working on a new Transformers live-action movie with Steven Spielberg and Michael Bay.

"We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise," said Michał Nowakowski, joint-CEO of CD Projekt, in a statement. "We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time."

Further info on the live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie adaptation, including who will write, direct, and star in the film, weren't announced. But you know who'd be a good live-action Johnny Silverhand? Keanu Reeves. Just an idea!

The futuristic sci-fi story of Cyberpunk 2077 is centered on the mercenary V, who accepts a job to steal a one-of-a-kind implant said to be the key to immortality. V is imbued with a cybernetic biochip that contains the memory and personality of legendary rock star (and terrorist) Johnny Silverhand, and the two are forced to work together to save V's life. The game's backdrop is the stylized and dystopian Night City, which is run by the powerful Arasaka Corporation.

Cyberpunk 2077 was released in 2020 — more than eight years after its original announcement — in an infamously dire state. In the following years, CD Projekt Red vastly improved upon the game , making it a fan favorite and delivering on the franchise's original cyberpunk vision. Cyberpunk 2077 has sold more than 40 million copies, according to Nowakowski. The developer released an expansion, Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty , in 2025.

Image: CD Projekt Red CD Projekt and Japanese animation studio Trigger have already adapted the world of Cyberpunk 2077 into an animated series, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , which began streaming on Netflix in 2022. A stand-alone sequel series, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 , is slated to premiere on Netflix on Oct. 20.

A video game sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 was announced in 2022 under the working title Project Orion. In May 2025, CD Projekt announced that the sequel, now known as Cyberpunk 2 , had entered pre-production. Cyberpunk 2 does not have an announced release date.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is the Next Game Set for a Live-Action Film
items.summary: But the producer attached will give you pause
items.content:
As every noteworthy video game under the sun gets a movie or TV series adaptation, it was only a matter of time before Cyberpunk 2077 found itself attached to a producer and a big-screen debut.

Now, it's reported by Deadline that Paramount Pictures will make a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film.

CD Projekt Red is involved in the project, and Paramount has attached Lorenzo di Bonaventura as the producer. Movies such as G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra and Transformers: The Last Knight are part of Bonaventura's back catalogue, which doesn't exactly fill me with confidence that this will be a quality adaptation.

However, if Bonaventura needs any casting tips, I think Keanu Reeves would make a really good Johnny Silverhand.

On the announcement, joint-CEO of CD Projekt Red, Michał Nowakowski, said : "We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time."

The Cyberpunk universe has already been adapted once, with the Edgerunners anime TV show proving very popular and becoming very well liked across two seasons. I don't expect this movie will quite reach the same kind of quality.

Bonaventura has also been involved in Madame Web , The Meg , and Pet Sematary .

items.content:
Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live!

This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Vehicles

  • Updated AutoDrive. When driving to a selected point, the vehicle now drives smoothly, overtakes blocking vehicles and no longer stops at traffic lights. Free Roam mode has also been upgraded to follow traffic rules and navigate the city more reliably.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Johnny always spawned in the passenger seat when using the Delamain Cab service.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where applying CrystalCoat to the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru caused its wheels to flash in different colors.

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Most of the new poses introduced in Update 2.3 now work with any gender.

    [/*]

  • Disabled NPC collision, which will make it easier to position NPCs on top of other objects with collision (e.g. on car hoods).

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where some of the poses didn't work for Royce.

    [/*]

Quests & Open World

  • Freedom - Fixed the journal entry that appears when the player chooses not to steal the Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred."

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where, after V fails to pursue and stop Semimaru and receives a text from River saying he'll contact V soon, the follow-up message never arrives.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where the Yaiba Semimaru could flip over during the chase, preventing the player from entering it.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - It's no longer possible to trigger the quest if River died during The Hunt.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Players can now acquire the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru through AUTOFIXER even if they failed The Hunt, which normally unlocks the side quest where the vehicle is obtained.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed a game crash that could occur in certain circumstances after leaving the Yaiba showroom event.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed an issue where the proxy interface UI in the Yaiba showroom is cut off when the "Larger HUD Elements" setting is enabled.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed several localization and lipsync issues in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle to disable vignette. It can be found in Settings → Graphics → Basic.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on PC and Mac where Ray-Traced Reflections might not display correctly when enabled under certain conditions.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several issues with displaying text messages from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Various fixes for fluff vendors.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Fixed an issue where NVIDIA Reflex could be disabled while DLSS Frame Generation was enabled, causing the screen to turn pink.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Path Tracing didn't activate properly in certain scenarios.

    [/*]

Mac-specific

  • Fixed an issue where changing graphics presets on Mac set Screen Space Reflections to a higher setting compared to the equivalent presets on PC.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing a permanent white screen when Frame Generation is enabled while entering the braindance in The Information.

    [/*]

  • Selecting "Defaults" in Video Settings no longer turns HDR Mode off.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where setting the MetalFX DRS Maximum Resolution above the value applied by the “For this Mac” preset could cause visual artifacts.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the inverted behavior of the "Mute Game in Background" toggle in Settings.

    [/*]

  • Removed the outdated "(Requires Game Restart)" disclaimer from the mouseover description of the "Disable Spatial Audio" setting.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on the App Store version that caused the game to become stuck on the “Press Space to continue” breaching screen.

    [/*]

  • Various stability and performance optimizations.

    [/*]

items.title: Update 2.3 Patch Notes
items.summary: Update 2.3 lands tomorrow! Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as sup
items.content:
Update 2.3 lands tomorrow!

Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as support for AMD FSR 3.1 Frame Generation, Intel XeSS 2.0 and HDR10+ Gaming, among others.

Update 2.3 also brings Cyberpunk 2077 to a whole new platform: Mac with Apple silicon! If you already own the game on Steam, you can play it on your compatible device. To find out whether your Mac can run Cyberpunk 2077, please check the official requirements.

Read the list of changes for more info:

Vehicles

  • Added 4 new vehicles, including several Side Jobs tied to acquiring them:

    • Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Hunt and The Beast In Me).

      An additional side job unlocks the CrystalCoat™ feature for it.

      [/*]

    • Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred"

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Beast in Me: Badlands, The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo, Transmission, and Search and Destroy)."

      [/*]

    • Yaiba ASM-R250 Muramasa

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, purchase 1 Yaiba vehicle, purchase at least 3 vehicles through AUTOFIXER, and complete Reported Crime: You Play with Fire...).

      If you fail the side job, the vehicle can later be purchased through AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]

    • Chevillon Legatus 450 Aquila

      Available for purchase on AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Introducing AutoDrive! This cutting-edge, autonomous driving feature will take you to your chosen destination (i.e. job objective or placed pin on the map). If you have no set destination, it will take you on a leisurely ride through the streets of Night City. Simply hop in any of your vehicles, make sure you're on a road, and hold G (PC) / Left Stick (consoles) to activate. This feature is disabled when you enter combat or when your vehicle is heavily damaged.

    [/*]

  • Implemented Cinematic Camera for AutoDrive. Hold Q (PC) / D-Pad Right (consoles) to activate. Sit back and enjoy cinematic views of Night City as you cruise toward your destination.

    [/*]

  • Self-driving Delamain cabs are now available on demand! Simply open the menu to call vehicles, then select "Delamain Cab" from the list to request a ride. This feature unlocks after completing the job Don't Lose Your Mind (regardless of outcome) and receiving a message from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ is now available for vehicles from partner brands, including motorcycles. Additionally, the infamous hacker known as Cosmetic_Troll exploited a vulnerability and created a cracked version of Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ technology for lower-end vehicles. Please note, however, that some models do not support the technology, such as heavily modded nomad vehicles and job-related vehicles.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color schemes did not work properly on the Mizutani Shion MZ1 and MZ2.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color scheme could not be applied properly to the Villefort Deleon "Vindicator".

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Added 27 new NPCs that can be spawned in Photo Mode, including Rita Wheeler, the Cassel twins, fixers, Dum Dum, the iguana, Brendan, and more.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between alternative outfits for NPCs spawned in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between V's saved Wardrobe outfits in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • Added a confirmation pop-up when exiting Photo Mode to prevent accidental exits after setting up the perfect shot.

    [/*]

  • Added more customization options to the Look-At Camera feature, including an option for only the character's eyes to turn toward the camera instead of their entire body.

    [/*]

  • Added improvements to Lighting:

    • Lights now spawn around the camera instead of the player character.

      [/*]

    • Added an outline to the spotlight mesh and an indicator when it's off screen for better visibility.

      [/*]

    • Improved light movement speed on controllers.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Added multiple new stickers and frames, including iconic quotes and stylish overlays that let you turn your screenshots into Night City postcards – perfect for sharing memories from the City of Dreams.

    [/*]

  • Improved Depth of Field and moved it to the Camera tab.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Color Balance tab, allowing you to create your own custom filters.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Time and Weather tab:

    • Weather: includes rain, acid rain, fog, sandstorm, pollution, and sunny.

      [/*]

    • Time of Day: changes the time of day within Photo Mode.

      [/*]

    • Frame Forward: advances through an unlimited amount of frames to capture the perfect shot.

      [/*]

    • Game Speed: allows in-game time to progress while in Photo Mode."

      [/*]
    [/*]

Quality of Life & Accessibility

  • The game will now detect if the player is using inverted mouse button settings and automatically adjusts in-game button prompts accordingly.

    [/*]

  • Added an option to toggle aiming down sights in Settings → Controls.

    [/*]

Jobs & Open World

  • Cyberpsycho Sighting: Bloody Ritual - the "Crack the ritualist's shard" objective now properly disappears from the Journal after completing the objective.

    [/*]

  • Sex on Wheels - now properly appears in the Journal after receiving the message from Jake Estevez.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where selecting a specific dialogue option in the conversation with Bree created a nameless, iconless item in the player's Inventory.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where the button to go to the lower level didn't appear on the elevator panel.

    [/*]

Gameplay
